from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_competing_causes_joint_cases_v1'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'不覆盖原提取：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
assert not (OUT/'完整原正文副本及价格表规范化.json').exists()
receipt=readj(OUT/'五原载体首次取得回执.json')
assert receipt['actual_raw_GETs']==5 and receipt['retries']==0 and all(r['status']=='GET_COMPLETED_FULL_ORIGINAL_SOURCE' for r in receipt['requests'])
save('同一原HTML正文副本与边界修正前登记.json',{'registered_at':now(),'issue':'2024原页面使用TRS_UEDITOR，初通用content选择包含桌面/移动副本及导航；不需要两表当两独立来源。原2020/2021TRS_Editor正文正常。','repair':'仅在已保存同一HTML选实际TRS_Editor/TRS_UEDITOR正文；核桌面移动原表/正文一致，保留完整初取与原HTML，未重GET。','old_receipt_sha256':sha(OUT/'五原载体首次取得回执.json'),'new_raw_GETs':0,'new_models':0,'stock_labels_read':False,'source_clocks_values_and_scope_unchanged':True})
records=[]
for rr in receipt['requests']:
 first=readj(ROOT/rr['parsed_full_record'])
 raw=ROOT/rr['source_path'];assert sha(raw)==rr['source_sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 bodies=soup.select('.TRS_Editor,.TRS_UEDITOR')
 assert len(bodies)==2,'桌面移动原正文身份异常'
 def compact(n):return re.sub(r'\s+','',n.get_text('',strip=True))
 assert compact(bodies[0])==compact(bodies[1]),'桌面移动原正文不同，不能去重'
 best=bodies[0];text=best.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 paragraphs=[p.get_text('',strip=True) for p in best.find_all('p')]
 paragraphs=[p for p in paragraphs if p]
 tables=[]
 for ti,t in enumerate(best.find_all('table')):
  rows=[]
  for ri,tr in enumerate(t.find_all('tr')):
   cells=[c.get_text(' ',strip=True) for c in tr.find_all(['td','th'],recursive=False)]
   if cells:rows.append({'native_row_index':ri,'native_cells':cells})
  tables.append({'native_table_index':ti,'native_rows':rows,'native_table_text':t.get_text('\n',strip=True)})
 rec={**{k:v for k,v in first.items() if k not in ['article_text','native_tables','all_visible_text']},'original_content_selector':'TRS_Editor_or_TRS_UEDITOR','desktop_and_mobile_original_content_identical':True,'desktop_and_mobile_not_independent_sources':True,'complete_original_article_text':text,'original_paragraphs':paragraphs,'complete_native_tables':tables,'initial_generic_body_saved_unchanged':True}
 if rr['role']=='NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE':
  assert len(tables)==1 and len(tables[0]['native_rows'])==52
  compacttext=compact(best);a=compacttext.index('附注')
  rec['native_method_and_scope_notes']=compacttext[a:]
  rec['native_statistics_classification']='GB/T4754-2017'
  rec['source_discloses_monthly_and_year_on_year_and_year_to_date_average_separately']=True
 else:
  a=next(i for i,p in enumerate(paragraphs) if re.sub(r'\s+','',p).startswith('二、PPI'))
  rec['original_PPI_cause_paragraphs']=paragraphs[a:]
 records.append(rec)
save('完整原正文副本及价格表规范化.json',{'normalized_at':now(),'records':records,'initial_same_source_2024_body_boundary_issue_preserved':True,'new_raw_GETs':0,'new_models':0,'new_labels':0,'financial_labels_read':False})
for r in records:
 print(json.dumps({'period':r['economic_period'],'role':r['role'],'native_tables':len(r['complete_native_tables']),'duplicate_body_confirmed_same':r['desktop_and_mobile_original_content_identical'],'native_method_notes':r.get('native_method_and_scope_notes'),'PPI_cause_paragraphs':r.get('original_PPI_cause_paragraphs')},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
